Counterparty: Oakfield Logistics GmbH
Effective: 1 September 2018

## 11. Assignment

Oakfield Logistics GmbH shall not assign this agreement without the provider's prior written consent.

selection_rationale: Assignment section is the primary locus for prohibitions on assignment to a competitor; excerpt supplies verbatim language to test whether the contract forbids competitor assignment.
known_missing_information: Section 11 requires consent but does not mention competitors.
